mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_record (fee_record_id, eir_id, company_id, amount, status, applicant, remark) VALUES (#{feeRecordId}, #{eirId}, #{companyId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{applicant}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_record WHERE eir_id = #{eirId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM refund_record WHERE fee_record_id = #{feeRecordId} AND status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM refund_record WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_record SET status = 'APPROVED', refund_no = #{refundNo}, approver = #{approver}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE refund_record SET status = 'REJECTED', approver = #{approver}, approved_at = NOW(), reject_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
